purpose: 完整地形母版转译47格，同母版粗/细粒度实际合屏，暖光固定
user_override: 用户明确快速实验/实机图/不用跑CI，并同意完整母版→47格与同形体粗细对照；不作整区发布

measurements.scope: Actual GPU still-image checks, not artistic or motion acceptance

verification.gallery: Chromium actual4report boards and20selector combinations; screenshot viewer only

implementation.pipeline: AI whole outer-block/hole master -> measured semantic crops -> original source_regions recipe ->47 actual cells×3grass banks -> coarse16 and fine32 nativeTileSet -> realApp exact-boundary material uses same source family
implementation.lighting: all modes .85 warm point emitters, same .98 ambient, original ground shadow geometry and small bloom; coarse output quantizes final light at2px
implementation.limits: solid and open-deck top only; existing hazard/moving/other regions unchanged; selected corner/edge semantics remain limited prototype, not approved full set

failures_retained: first generated sheet shifted source layout and wrapped green down sides; raw archived, not consumed

captures_r1 completed with shader global non-constant error and white boundaries; failed log+shader retained, not signed passed; changed to local function argument, captures_r2 and final deliver error-free
coarse whole-world experiment was initially easy to mistake for tile-only; added separately labeled terrain_coarse control; reviewer confirmed isolation

design.reason: 执行用户已同意的完整母版→47格组织，固定暖光，明确区分全世界粗细和只改地形

technical.reason: 限定最终Godot退出0、20图、无shader/script错误、灯记录一致、同源降采样与141格资源计数；不是CI

formal_integration.reason: 仅显式开发Lab，正式默认和其他区域未迁移

visual.reason: 独审认为更适合继续，但草沿厚/重复、侧壁包边、岩体层次不足

animation.reason: 定位冻结截图，未验连续移动/滚屏

audio_vfx.reason: 局部暖光静态可见且参数固定；未听完整音轨/看动态

gameplay.reason: 不改Motor、物理、生成、资源、RNG和保存；不签通关

performance.reason: llvmpipe静态图不代表真机性能

independent_review.reason: 不同代理实际查看7图+最终2图，指出对照混淆并复核新控制；只签审查发生

player_acceptance.reason: 粗细尚未由用户选择，材质未定稿
